channel.title: Mozambique - The African Street Journal
channel.description: Daily news from Mozambique, every source cited.

item.title: Mozambique government to brief parliament on health, roads, and climate
item.description: Parliamentary groups demand details on El Niño impact, National Road 1 repairs, and Nampula General Hospital construction delays.

item.title: Maputo Central Hospital resumes cancer treatment after fire
item.description: 95 percent of patient records were saved from the blaze that damaged the oncology unit.

item.title: Mozambique's former defence minister Joaquim Tobias Dai dies
item.description: Dai served as minister from 2000 to 2008 and was a veteran of the National Liberation Struggle.

item.title: Mozambique plans $189.8 million agricultural campaign
item.description: The 2026/27 plan includes emergency support for producers affected by El Niño and investment in agribusiness.

item.title: Maputo hospital fire destroys oncology service
item.description: Staff evacuated 22 patients safely from Maputo Central Hospital's oncology unit after a fire broke out Sunday morning.
